signatures.description: Write an adaptive Bezier path flattener that turns a stream of cubic and quadratic segments into polylines whose maximum deviation from the true curve stays under a caller-supplied device-pixel tolerance, while keeping the vertex count within a factor of two of uniform-parameter sampling at the same error. It must handle cusps, inflections, near-degenerate control points and very large coordinates without catastrophic cancellation, using recursive subdivision with a certified flatness test instead of fixed step counts. Emit a per-segment report with the achieved deviation bound and terminate cleanly when the requested tolerance is below floating-point resolution.
